  <name>Task 1: Create the production bucket and the API IAM user in the AWS console</name>
  <read_first>

  <action>Create the S3 bucket and IAM user in the AWS console (D-14 makes these human steps), then hand the credential to this session.</action>
  <instructions>
    Claude prepared the policy JSON (SPEC-storage-s3 section 5) and the integration spec that will verify the result. In the AWS console:
    1. S3 -> Create bucket `character-dossier-prod` in your chosen region. Keep "Block all public access" ON. Default encryption SSE-S3. Versioning disabled. Object Lock disabled.
    2. The bucket -> Management -> Lifecycle rule "abort-incomplete-multipart": apply to all objects, "Delete expired object delete markers or incomplete multipart uploads" -> incomplete multipart after 1 day. No expiration rules.
    3. IAM -> Users -> Create user `character-dossier-api` (no console access). Attach an inline policy pasted verbatim from SPEC-storage-s3 section 5. Attach nothing else.
    4. Security credentials -> Create access key (use case: application running outside AWS).
    5. Paste the region, access key id and secret access key into this session. Claude uses them only as process environment for the next task and will not write them to disk.
    Do not create CloudFront, ACM, the admin user or the billing alarm now (D-14).
  </instructions>
  <verification>Task 2 runs the integration spec against the bucket and confirms list denial.</verification>
  <acceptance_criteria>
    - The human confirmed steps 1-4 and supplied region, key id and secret in the session.
  </acceptance_criteria>
  <resume-signal>Paste "done" with the region and the key pair</resume-signal>
</task>
